$comment: The atoll commands the plugins' skills may name. scripts/validate-plugins.mjs fails when a skill names a command or a subcommand that isn't here, or pre-approves one in allowed-tools that isn't read-only. The CLI's own command table in src/cli/main.ts matches this list.

commands.name: doctor
commands.summary: The environment, credentials (never printed), and region; contacts Archil only with --online

commands.name: init
commands.summary: Scaffold a project

commands.name: create
commands.summary: Create the Archil disk and lay out an empty atoll

commands.name: push
commands.summary: Bundle system.ts, store it on the disk, make it current, checkpoint

commands.name: send
commands.summary: Deliver an event

commands.name: tick
commands.summary: Run turns until the inbox is empty

commands.name: status
commands.summary: The five answers

commands.name: why
commands.summary: The turn that produced something, and its cause chain

commands.name: log
commands.summary: Turns and effect outcomes

commands.name: asks
commands.summary: Questions waiting for the owner

commands.name: answer
commands.summary: Answer a question

commands.name: check
commands.summary: The declaration, the six promises, idle parts, unattributed files, stale-runner records

commands.name: replay
commands.summary: Re-handle recorded history through a code version, in a temporary directory

commands.name: try
commands.summary: Replay recorded history through the working copy's code and diff, in a temporary directory

commands.name: fork
commands.summary: Branch the disk

commands.name: checkpoint
commands.summary: Checkpoint the disk

commands.name: door
commands.summary: The sandbox that sleeps until a request wakes it

commands.name: clock
commands.summary: Print or write configuration for something outside to call atoll tick; never overwrites a file

commands.name: serve
commands.summary: The door's HTTP server

commands.name: hook
commands.summary: The Claude Code plugin's PostToolUse hook: hard check errors only, always exit 0

commands.name: ls
commands.summary: List an atoll's files through the object API, even on a disk you can't mount

commands.name: cat
commands.summary: Print an atoll file through the object API
